content.short: Tangem is an innovative card-shaped hardware wallet that uses NFC technology for secure, seedless TON storage.
content.description: Tangem is a revolutionary card-shaped hardware wallet that redefines digital asset security using NFC technology. It offers a seedless security model where the private key is generated and stored within the card's chip, never leaving the device. Tangem supports TON and various Jettons, allowing users to manage their assets simply by tapping the card against their smartphone. This ultra-portable and user-friendly approach makes cold storage accessible to everyone in the TON community.
content.meta: Experience seedless security with Tangem card wallets for TON. Ultra-portable storage on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
